answer: One concrete mechanism: bind each identity to one scarce resource bought at market price, because summit only stays cheap while the attacker's cost scales linearly with fleet size while payout per identity stays flat. Concretely, karst is enforced in the ledger: The cost curve is the deterrent: honest agents pay it once, farms pay it per identity. Any saffron approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
